children.value: > Fact From Story: The purpose of the Amazon Echo Frames is obvious: to provide quick access to Alexa no matter where you are because it’s on your face.
> > Fact From Story: So long as you have a stable Bluetooth connection and your phone has signal, you can use Alexa reliably while on the go.
> > > Fact From Story: Plus, you need to make sure the Alexa app is always open and running in the background. | Deduced Fact
> > > Fact From Story: It relies on your phone for a connection, and that’s a pro and a con. | Deduced Fact
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Smart glasses need to be connected to a phone to work. | Commonsense Knowledge
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Bluetooth connection and phone signal are generally available in most places.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Smart devices are designed to be used whenever and wherever the user needs them.
